messages.content: Can I determine if the symbol 'getVersion' is readable in the native function interface library associated with the current object?

function.name: NFILibrary_isMemberReadable
function.description: Checks if the specified symbol is readable in the native function interface library associated with the current object. Note that the provided function is in Java 8 SDK syntax.

symbol.description: The symbol to check for readability. This is Java String type parameter in string representation.

recursive.description: The InteropLibrary instance used for recursive checks (automatically provided by the runtime). Default null This parameter can be of any type of Java object in string representation.
